tickets.summary: Add database index on users.email for login query performance
tickets.description: The login query (SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL) is performing a sequential scan on the users table (1.2M rows). Current p95 latency is 800ms. Adding a composite index on (email, deleted_at) should bring this down to <50ms. The query is in src/repositories/user-repository.ts line 47.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Composite index created on users(email, deleted_at)
* Login query uses index scan (verified via EXPLAIN ANALYZE)
* p95 latency for login query drops from 800ms to <50ms
* Index creation does not lock the table (use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY)
* Existing queries not negatively impacted (check slow query log for 24h after deploy)
tickets.test_plan: Verify via EXPLAIN ANALYZE in staging. Monitor slow query log post-deploy. Benchmark login endpoint before/after with 1000 concurrent requests.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: single index on users table. Out of scope: query rewriting, ORM changes, table partitioning.
